title: Ordinary canonical bridge preserves direct-image composition
statement: For section-normalized operations and ordinary compositors $o,c$ [def-sf-integral-system-operations] and a canonical bridge $b$ [def-sf-integral-system-canonical-bridge], let $D_f$ and $R_f$ be the chosen and intrinsic ordinary direct-image functors on coefficient sequence modules, and let $c_{f,g}$ and $s_{f,g}$ be their ordinary compositors [lem-sf-semilinear-proper-open-mate-pasting]. For schemes $X,Y,Z$ and maps $f:X\to Y$, $g:Y\to Z$, the natural isomorphisms satisfy $c_{f,g};b_{fg}=D_f(b_g);R_g(b_f);s_{f,g}$.

source.place: Proper/open pasting for the canonical transported gamma; compatibility of the direct-image compositors (Stacks 03D8, 07A7).

proof.text: Apply section extensionality at each (n,U). The ordinary bridge components are the identity on sections. The supplied compositor sections field and the intrinsic compositor section formula restrict along the same canonical map of iterated fibre products, so the two composite components are equal.

lean.statement:
theorem integralSystemOrdinaryBridgeComposition (o : Operations l E) (c : Compositors l E o)
    (b : CanonicalBridge l E o) {X Y Z : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z) :
    c.ordinaryDirect f g ≪≫ b.ordinary (f ≫ g) =
      Functor.isoWhiskerLeft (pullbackTensorSequenceDirect l E f) (b.ordinary g) ≪≫
        Functor.isoWhiskerRight (b.ordinary f)
          (ProEtale.SemilinearProperOpen.push (scalarRings l E) (scalarTransitions l E) g) ≪≫
        ProEtale.SemilinearProperOpen.pushComp
          (scalarRings l E) (scalarTransitions l E) f g
